settings.name: USE_GRPC
settings.description: **Enable gRPC:** Set to `yes` to enable gRPC proxying.

settings.name: GRPC_HOST
settings.description: **gRPC Upstream:** Value used by `grpc_pass` (for example `grpc://service:50051` or `grpcs://...`).

settings.name: GRPC_URL
settings.description: **Location URL:** Path that will be proxied to the gRPC upstream.

settings.name: GRPC_CUSTOM_HOST
settings.description: **Custom Host Header:** Overrides `Host` header sent upstream.

settings.name: GRPC_HEADERS
settings.description: **Extra Upstream Headers:** Semicolon-separated list of `grpc_set_header` values.

settings.name: GRPC_HIDE_HEADERS
settings.description: **Hidden Response Headers:** Space-separated list of `grpc_hide_header` values.

settings.name: GRPC_HEADERS_CLIENT
settings.description: **Client Response Headers:** Semicolon-separated list of `add_header` values sent to the client.

settings.name: GRPC_PASS_HEADERS
settings.description: **Passed Response Headers:** Space-separated list of `grpc_pass_header` values, to forward headers NGINX hides by default.

settings.name: GRPC_IGNORE_HEADERS
settings.description: **Ignored Response Headers:** Space-separated list of `grpc_ignore_headers` values, to stop NGINX processing them.

settings.name: GRPC_UNDERSCORES_IN_HEADERS
settings.description: **Allow Underscores in Headers:** Enables/disables `underscores_in_headers`.

settings.name: GRPC_INTERCEPT_ERRORS
settings.description: **Intercept Errors:** Enables/disables `grpc_intercept_errors`.

settings.name: GRPC_BUFFER_SIZE
settings.description: **Buffer Size:** Value for `grpc_buffer_size` (buffer used to read the upstream response).

settings.name: GRPC_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Connect Timeout:** Timeout for establishing connection to upstream.

settings.name: GRPC_READ_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Read Timeout:** Timeout for reading from upstream.

settings.name: GRPC_SEND_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Send Timeout:** Timeout for sending to upstream.

settings.name: GRPC_SOCKET_KEEPALIVE
settings.description: **Socket Keepalive:** Enables/disables upstream socket keepalive.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_SNI
settings.description: **SSL SNI:** Enables/disables SNI for TLS upstreams.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_SNI_NAME
settings.description: **SSL SNI Name:** SNI name to send when `GRPC_SSL_SNI=yes`.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_VERIFY
settings.description: **SSL Verify:** Enables/disables verification of the gRPC upstream certificate.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_PRIORITY
settings.description: **Trusted Certificate Priority:** Source of the CA bundle, `file` or `data`.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE
settings.description: **Trusted Certificate Path:** Path to a PEM CA bundle readable by the scheduler (priority `file`).

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_DATA
settings.description: **Trusted Certificate Data:** CA bundle as base64 or plaintext PEM (priority `data`).

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_VERIFY_DEPTH
settings.description: **SSL Verify Depth:** Verification depth in the upstream certificate chain.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_CERT_PRIORITY
settings.description: **Client Certificate Priority:** Source of the client certificate and key, `file` or `data`.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_CERT
settings.description: **Client Certificate Path:** PEM client certificate presented to the upstream for mutual TLS (priority `file`).

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_CERT_DATA
settings.description: **Client Certificate Data:** Client certificate as base64 or plaintext PEM (priority `data`).

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_KEY
settings.description: **Client Key Path:** PEM private key matching the client certificate (priority `file`). It must not be encrypted.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_KEY_DATA
settings.description: **Client Key Data:** Client private key as base64 or plaintext PEM (priority `data`).

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_CRL
settings.description: **CRL Path:** PEM revocation list applied when verifying the upstream. Takes precedence over the CRL data setting.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_CRL_DATA
settings.description: **CRL Data:** Revocation list as base64 or plaintext PEM. Used only when the CRL path is empty.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_PROTOCOLS
settings.description: **Upstream SSL Protocols:** TLS versions offered to the upstream. Empty keeps the NGINX default.

settings.name: GRPC_SSL_CIPHERS
settings.description: **Upstream SSL Ciphers:** Cipher suite string offered to the upstream. Empty keeps the NGINX default.

settings.name: GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM
settings.description: **Next Upstream Conditions:** Value for `grpc_next_upstream`.

settings.name: GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Next Upstream Timeout:** Value for `grpc_next_upstream_timeout`.

settings.name: GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM_TRIES
settings.description: **Next Upstream Tries:** Value for `grpc_next_upstream_tries`.

settings.name: GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST
settings.description: **Auth Request:** Value for `auth_request`, to authenticate through an external provider.

settings.name: GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST_SIGNIN_URL
settings.description: **Auth Request Signin URL:** Redirect target when the auth request returns 401.

settings.name: GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST_SET
settings.description: **Auth Request Set:** Semicolon-separated list of `auth_request_set` values.

settings.name: GRPC_INCLUDES
settings.description: **Additional Includes:** Space-separated include files added inside the gRPC `location` block.

settings.name: GRPC_MAX_CLIENT_SIZE
settings.description: **Maximum Body Size:** Value for `client_max_body_size` in this location (`0` for infinite). Falls back to the service `MAX_CLIENT_SIZE`.
